input.subject: URGENT: Login failures affecting our entire team
input.body:
Hi TechFlow Support,

Since this morning, our entire team of 45 users is unable to log in to the platform from mobile devices. We're getting 'Authentication token validation failed' errors.

This is critical for us as we rely on the mobile app for field operations. Please treat this as P0.

We need an immediate fix or a workaround.

Regards,
John Davis
CTO, Acme Corp

description: Customer P0 escalation - should extract urgent login fix task

input.subject: [Dependabot] Critical security vulnerabilities detected
input.body:
Dependabot has detected 3 critical security vulnerabilities in your repository:

1. CVE-2026-1234: Remote code execution in lodash (CVSS 9.8)
2. CVE-2026-5678: SQL injection in mysql2 (CVSS 9.1)
3. CVE-2026-9012: Authentication bypass in jsonwebtoken (CVSS 8.9)

All public exploits are available. Patch immediately.

description: Security advisory - should extract patching task

input.subject: SSO Integration Requirements - Contract Signed
input.body:
Dear Sunita,

Following our contract signing, we need to discuss the SSO integration timeline. Our requirements:

1. SAML 2.0 support
2. Azure AD integration
3. Role mapping from our directory
4. MFA enforcement
5. Session management

We expect this to be completed within 2 weeks as per our agreement. Can we schedule a kickoff meeting this week?

Best regards,
Sarah Chen
VP Engineering, GlobalTech
